description:
The windowless CLI test can fail even when the hidden pane is listed correctly. Its hidden-pane assertion finds the first line containing the pane callsign anywhere, then requires that line to follow the hidden heading.

During the 2026-10-27 round, the generated callsign was `wind`. The assertion matched `no window answered` in the header before reaching the correct `wind` row under `hidden`. All 104 messaging tests passed; this was the only failing test function. Evidence: /tmp/muster-round-20261027.6S6lF0/check-1-human-remote.log and findings-1-human-remote.md.

Match the callsign column when locating the pane row. The captured output demonstrates the defect; keep the assertion repair separate from the remote human-join production fix. Relevant history: 901c789b3 introduced the substring assertion and e2822dd44 changed the input from an ID to a callsign.
title: CLI hidden-pane assertion can match a callsign in the header
